host_feature_catalog.runtime_readiness_owner: browser Host after Plugin runtime registration
host_feature_catalog.presentation_icon_precedence: for catalog-backed panels, frontend_integration.catalog.icon is canonical in the Host main shell; the registered WorkspacePanelDefinition.icon is the fallback for panels without a catalog entry

registerWorkspacePanel.side_effect: registers or replaces one panel in the plugin-owned namespace; replacing an active panel disposes it first

unregisterWorkspacePanel.side_effect: disposes and closes the matching active panel before removing its definition

openWorkspacePanel.side_effect: opens one interactive Server-owned workspace; another active workspace is disposed before replacement

closeWorkspacePanel.side_effect: disposes and clears the matching active panel

placement.description: toolbar is the current Agent composer entry surface; legacy sidebar is accepted and normalized to toolbar because the four-page shell has no sidebar

workspace_mount_contract.dispose_failure: closeWorkspacePanel throws; Host-initiated cleanup logs; both paths clear the active panel
workspace_mount_contract.switch_panel: dispose old panel then mount new panel
workspace_mount_contract.plugin_reload_disable_uninstall: dispose active panel and unregister all plugin-owned panels
workspace_mount_contract.reentrant_lifecycle_calls: throw; mount and dispose must not call registerWorkspacePanel, unregisterWorkspacePanel, openWorkspacePanel, or closeWorkspacePanel
workspace_mount_contract.invalid_behavior: throw; never fall back to a modal, toolbar, or another placement

workspace_collections.purpose: group related catalog-opened main-placement panels under one Server-rendered tab list
workspace_collections.membership: optional collection metadata on WorkspacePanelDefinition; collected panels may belong to different enabled plugins
workspace_collections.metadata_consistency: panels sharing one collection id must use identical title, icon, and order
workspace_collections.placement: collection panels must include main and use main as defaultPlacement
workspace_collections.ordering: collections sort by order then id; tabs sort by tabOrder then pluginId and panelId
workspace_collections.lifecycle: switching tabs uses the normal single-workspace dispose-before-mount contract
workspace_collections.focus: collection and tab controls keep ordinary browser focus on the activated Host control; they do not grant plugin-scoped Host entry focus authorization

layout.right: chat and workspace remain visible and interactive
layout.main: chat DOM and state remain mounted but are visually hidden
layout.narrow_screen: all requested placements render as main at 1024px or narrower
layout.short_screen: top and bottom render as main at 420px or shorter

focus.host_focus_authorization: all conditions must hold: a Host-rendered Agent composer toolbar entry is synchronously dispatching its onClick callback, navigator.userActivation.isActive is true, the entry pluginId equals the workspace owner, and the Host trigger remains connected
focus.authorized_open: focus the Server-owned workspace title after the workspace is visible; opening the same already-visible workspace also focuses that title
focus.unauthorized_open: preserve the current focus, including direct API calls during unrelated transient activation, asynchronous callback continuations, module callbacks, timers, and cross-owner opens
focus.close_after_host_focus: restore the most recent authorized connected Host trigger
focus.mount_or_replacement_failure_after_host_: restore the most recent authorized connected Host trigger

horizontal_wheel.listener: one document-level wheel listener registered with passive false during Host initialization
horizontal_wheel.root_behavior: consume horizontal-dominant wheel gestures and Shift+wheel across the ChatRaw page so they cannot fall through to browser history navigation or root rubber-banding
horizontal_wheel.scroll_target: move the nearest ancestor with computed overflow-x auto or scroll and scrollWidth greater than clientWidth; consume the gesture at both edges

security.ownership: lifecycle namespace, not a security sandbox
forbidden: ChatRaw private DOM or Alpine internals
required: plugin-owned event and subscription cleanup in dispose
styles scoped below the assigned workspace container

preserve_extension_points: legacy sidebar button declarations normalized to toolbar buttons
